method_note: Humanoids 2025 (Seoul, Sep 30-Oct 2, 2025); the 2026 edition (Santa Clara, Dec 6-9, 2026) has not yet taken place. Its technical program has no topical session names (4 single-track "Oral Session" + 4 "Interactive Session" blocks), so program-sessions could not be used. Instead counted all 180 papers in the PaperCept program (26 oral + 154 interactive; read from Internet Archive snapshots because the live PaperCept pages now return 404/403) and mapped each paper's author-selected PaperCept keywords to taxonomy ids; each paper contributes weight 1 split equally across its first 2 distinct mapped ids (1 paper(s) had no mappable keyword). Weight = share of 179 mapped papers. top_terms are taken from the most frequent PaperCept paper keywords because session titles are generic. Keywords below 0.02 omitted; listed weights sum to 0.934. deployable-structures: none found in the 180 Humanoids 2025 PaperCept paper titles (searched deploy/origami/fold/tensegrity/inflat/kirigami/extendable/boom/telescopic; kirigami/telescopic/inflatable appear only inside abstracts of hand, leg and wearable papers whose primary topic lies elsewhere).
